# Antietam — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("When and where was Antietam?", "1862, Bloodiest US day"),
    ("What is Antietam known for?", "~22,700 casualties"),
    ("What is when/where?", "1862, Bloodiest US day"),
    ("What is what happened?", "~22,700 casualties"),
    ("What is significance?", "Emancipation Proclamation followed"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
